name: pickup_archive_write_all
description: Writes pickup archive records for primary-list spawns whose pickup object carries the persisted pickup flag.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent pickup.cpp source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41e780 validates primary-list traversal, pickup-object flag filtering, 0x30-byte PickupArchiveRecord layout, section token from pickup object name, first-record flag handling, and WriteSectionBlob result propagation. The native smoke validates emitted records and archive paths.
